items.title: 69537_Jimmy Jones oral history interview
items.q: And of course our principals, Lil Greenwood, Joya Sherrill, and Buddy Briggs.

ctx.x: Yeah. No, he seemed in fine spirits, like he felt good, and I think he did feel good then.

Yeah. And when Jerome Richardson called me up and said, "I've got some news," you know, and I didn't know what it was, you know. I thought maybe something might have happened to Quincy again. And he said, "No, this time it's Buddy. He's gone." You know, I guess he probably had one of those coronaries or something.
Yeah. They say right while he was playing in the pit. He was doing a show. He was doing, I think -- was it "Guys and Dolls?"
